title: Activity gets a clearer picture of usage and earnings
summary:
A clearer Activity dashboard, searchable models, Muse Spark 1.1, and documentation that points to the right places.

Enter’s Activity tab now brings API usage, app markup earnings, and community model rewards into a paginated Last events feed. Charts switch between Pollen and request counts, with filters for keys, models, apps, and community models. Usage exports distinguish API keys, and duplicate events no longer inflate charts, transactions, or CSVs. The data window starts on January 1, 2026.

Community-contributed search in the dashboard’s Models section filters by name, description, or brand without switching tabs. An All tab is now the default, so the catalog starts with the whole catalog rather than just images.

Meta Muse Spark 1.1 was added as a paid-only text model. It accepts text and up to 10 reference images, supports tools and reasoning, and has a 1,048,576-token context window.
